findings.F1: The pooled result rests on a few large winners. After forecast ≥ 10, the mean 10-bar excess is +0.021 (t 0.90, 69 non-overlapping cases), but the median is −0.016 and only 48% of cases are positive. Dropping the 5% largest absolute moves brings the mean to −0.0005 (t −0.03, 65 cases), and XRP alone averages +0.119 with a median of −0.019 (11 cases).
findings.F2: When the coin was still falling into the signal, the rebound is concentrated there. Top-forecast bars with a negative 3-day return average +0.043 excess (median +0.006, 55% positive, t 1.27, 42 cases). Those with a positive 3-day return average −0.014 (37% positive, t −0.51, 27 cases). The 5-day split gives the same picture: +0.036 (t 1.26, 50 cases) against −0.019 (19 cases).
findings.F3: The same split holds in the deepest fifth of in-regime distance below the 200-day SMA, and it shows up in both directions. A negative 3-day return gives +0.028 excess (t 1.32, 76 cases). A positive 3-day return, meaning the bounce has already started, gives −0.034 (35% positive, t −2.38, 83 cases).
findings.F4: The market's own moves drown the effect. Top-forecast 10-bar returns correlate 0.80 with the cross-coin mean return over the same 10 bars. Subtracting that mean cuts the standard deviation from 0.19 to 0.12 and raises the t from 0.90 to 1.40 (mean +0.021, 64 cases).
findings.F5: One period dominates the cases and drags the result down. 2022 holds 32 of the 69 top-forecast cases (28 of them in window w2), averaging −0.019 excess with 38% positive (t −0.76). Most other years are positive, for example 2024 at +0.105 (t 2.03, 6 cases) and 2020 at +0.059 (4 cases).
findings.F6: Depth alone does not sort outcomes inside the high-volatility regime. All five quintiles of distance from the 200-day SMA have mean excess between −0.009 and 0.000, with |t| ≤ 0.53 and 159 cases each.

ideas.idea: When a coin's daily close is far below its 200-day average in a high-volatility stretch and it has still fallen over the last three days, it rises more than its usual drift over the next ten days.
ideas.consequence: Buy capitulation only while the coin is still falling into the signal, not after it has already started to bounce.
ideas.name: still-falling deep capitulation rebound

ideas.idea: When a coin's daily close is far below its 200-day average in a high-volatility stretch but it has risen over the last three days, it falls back below its usual drift over the next ten days.
ideas.consequence: Refuse long entries on deep-discount coins whose short bounce has already begun, because that bounce tends to fade.
ideas.name: early bounce fades below trend

ideas.idea: When a coin's daily close is far below its 200-day average in a high-volatility stretch and it fell over the last three days, it outperforms the average of the other coins over the next ten days.
ideas.consequence: Hold the deep-discount coin against the rest of the market rather than outright, to remove the market's swing that hides the rebound.
ideas.name: capitulated coin beats market
ideas.data: instruments: BTC, ETH, LTC, XMR, XRP, ZEC together as a cross-coin average; bar: 1d; period: folds A, B, C, D
